official_sources.source_identity: Gravity Wiz first-party product update naming the terminal Gravity Perks parent-plugin release v2.3.17
Spellbook documentation establishing replacement of the Gravity Perks platform plugin

capability_observations.summary: Gravity Perks v2.3.17 fixes Spellbook activation during migration. Current first-party Spellbook documentation states that Spellbook replaced the Gravity Perks platform plugin and assumes installation, licensing, and update responsibility. The radar therefore treats 2.3.17 as the terminal parent-plugin release identity, not as a rolling feed that could discover later parent-plugin versions.

If the Owner later supplies a Spellbook-era parent authority or another exact package intended to replace the admitted Gravity Perks parent package, PersianGravity must reconcile exact product/domain/source identity before changing localization admission. Child perks remain separate explicit profiles and are not enrolled by this radar.
